brief: A small display stand: three bases meeting at a corner with a raised platform on a spike at that corner.

requirements.requirement: Three bases meeting at a corner
requirements.evidence: Three full bases piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full and piece:0,1,0;full form one joined triangular cluster at level 0.

requirements.requirement: A raised platform on a spike at that corner
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 stands at the shared junction of the three bases, fitted with the large platform accessory (platform-lrg, 60mm plate).

Open faces capped (12 solid caps) and joints locked (3 joint bolts); check_build ok with meshClash clear. No prop was staged: the spike platform reports no prop surface in this configurator, so the platform is left empty as the display surface itself.

finish.summary: A compact triangular display stand: three full hex bases meeting at a central corner, with a mount spike rising from that junction carrying a large flat platform plate. Open faces are capped and the three internal joints are bolted; the build checks clean with no mesh clashes.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
